defs.d: In a lower place.
On a lower storey.
Lower in spatial position than.
defs.ex: The treasure is buried two meters below the surface.

defs.d: Within the writing of a given document which follows a particular appearance of the word "below".
defs.ex: "By their execution hereof, the Parties incur a legal obligation to pass consideration under this Loan Contract as is set forth below."

defs.d: Awe-inspiring, majestic, noble, venerable.
defs.ex: an august patron of the arts

defs.d: Of noble birth.
defs.ex: an august lineage

defs.d: To incur a charge of; to require payment of a (specified) price.
defs.ex: It will cost you a lot of money to take a trip around the world.

defs.d: To cause something to be lost; to cause the expenditure or relinquishment of.
defs.ex: Trying to rescue the man from the burning building cost them their lives.

defs.d: A large body of salt water.
A lake, especially if large or if salty or brackish.
defs.ex: The Caspian Sea, the Sea of Galilee, the Salton Sea, etc.

defs.d: The achievement of one's aim or goal.
defs.ex: His third attempt to pass the entrance exam was a success.

defs.d: Financial profitability.
defs.ex: Don't let success go to your head.

defs.d: One of four seasons, traditionally the second, marked by the longest and typically hottest days of the year due to the inclination of the Earth and thermal lag. Typically regarded as being from June 21 to September 22 or 23 in parts of the USA, the months of June, July and August in the United Kingdom and the months of December, January and February in the Southern Hemisphere.
defs.ex: the heat of summer

defs.d: Year; used to give the age of a person, usually a young one.
defs.ex: He was barely eighteen summers old.

defs.d: To spend the summer, as in a particular place on holiday.
defs.ex: We like to summer in the Mediterranean.

defs.d: Traditionally the fourth of the four seasons, typically regarded as being from December 23 to March 20 in continental regions of the Northern Hemisphere or the months of June, July and August in the Southern Hemisphere. It is the time when the sun is lowest in the sky, resulting in short days, and the time of year with the lowest atmospheric temperatures for the region.
The period of decay, old age, death, or the like.
To spend the winter (in a particular place).
defs.ex: When they retired, they hoped to winter in Florida.

defs.d: To store something (for instance animals) somewhere over winter to protect it from cold.
(reflexive pronoun) Your own self (singular).
defs.ex: Be careful with that fire or you'll burn yourself.

defs.d: You (singular); used emphatically, especially to indicate exclusiveness of the referent's participation in the predicate, i.e., that no one else is involved.
defs.ex: After a good night's sleep you'll feel like yourself again.

defs.d: The process of childbearing; the beginning of life.
An instance of childbirth.
defs.ex: Intersex babies account for roughly one per cent of all births.

defs.d: To bear or give birth to (a child).
To produce, give rise to.
A familial relationship established by childbirth.
defs.ex: Her birth father left when she was a baby; she was raised by her mother and stepfather.

defs.d: A human being, whether man, woman or child.
defs.ex: Humans share common ancestors with other apes.

defs.d: To behave as or become, or to cause to behave as or become, a human.
(notcomp) Of or belonging to the species Homo sapiens or its closest relatives.
Having the nature or attributes of a human being.
defs.ex: To err is human; to forgive, divine.

defs.d: A transport system using rails used to move passengers or goods.
A track, consisting of parallel rails, over which wheeled vehicles such as trains may travel.
Power, strength, force or influence held by a person or group.
Physical strength or force.
defs.ex: He pushed with all his might, but still it would not move.

defs.d: Mighty; powerful.
Possible.
A thin bed cloth used as a covering for a mattress or as a layer over the sleeper.
defs.ex: Use the sheets in the hall closet to make the bed.

defs.d: A piece of paper, usually rectangular, that has been prepared for writing, artwork, drafting, wrapping, manufacture of packaging (boxes, envelopes, etc.), and for other uses. The word does not include scraps and irregular small pieces destined to be recycled, used for stuffing or cushioning or paper mache, etc.
defs.ex: A sheet of paper measuring eight and one-half inches wide by eleven inches high is a popular item in commerce.

defs.d: To cover or wrap with cloth, or paper, or other similar material.
defs.ex: Remember to sheet the floor before you start painting.

defs.d: To form into sheets.
The Earth's moon Luna; the sole natural satellite of the Earth, represented in astronomy and astrology by ☾.
The god of the Moon in Heathenry.
(by extension of Moon) Any natural satellite of a planet.
defs.ex: That's no moon, you idiot... it's a space station!

defs.d: A month, particularly a lunar month.
defs.ex: They stayed with their aunt and uncle for many moons.

defs.d: To display one's buttocks to, typically as a jest, insult, or protest.
defs.ex: It was ill-advised of Sam to moon the photographer during the shoot.

defs.d: (usually followed by over or after) To fuss over something adoringly; to be infatuated with someone.
defs.ex: Sarah mooned over Sam's photograph for months.

defs.d: The act of assigning; the allocation of a job or a set of tasks.
defs.ex: This flow chart represents the assignment of tasks in our committee.

defs.d: The categorization of something as belonging to a specific category.
defs.ex: We should not condone the assignment of asylum seekers to that of people smugglers.

defs.d: An uncertain duration of time, a period of time.
defs.ex: He lectured for quite a long while.

defs.d: To pass (time) idly.
To occupy or entertain (someone) in order to let time pass.
Until.
That which follows something on which it depends; that which is produced by a cause.
A result of actions, especially if such a result is unwanted or unpleasant.
defs.ex: I'm warning you. If you don't get me the report on time, there will be consequences.

defs.d: To threaten or punish (a child, etc.) with specific consequences for misbehaviour.
An extremely long time.
defs.ex: I haven't seen him in forever!

defs.d: A mythical time in the infinite future that will never come.
defs.ex: Sure, I'd be happy to meet with you on the 12th of forever.

defs.d: Permanent, lasting
(duration) For all time, for all eternity; for a lifetime; for an infinite amount of time.
defs.ex: I shall love you forever.

defs.d: (duration) For a very long time, a seeming eternity.
defs.ex: We had to wait forever to get inside.

defs.d: The power to affect, control or manipulate something or someone; the ability to change the development of fluctuating things such as conduct, thoughts or decisions.
defs.ex: I have absolutely no influence over him.

defs.d: An action exerted by a person or thing with such power on another to cause change.
defs.ex: I'm not able to exercise influence over him.

defs.d: To have an effect on by using gentle or subtle action; to exert an influence upon; to modify, bias, or sway; to persuade or induce.
defs.ex: I must admit that this book influenced my outlook on life.

defs.d: To exert, make use of one's influence.
A rural area, or the rural part of a larger area.
defs.ex: We live in the Swedish countryside.

defs.d: A rural landscape.
Freedom provided by the cessation of activities.
Free time, time free from work or duties.
To sadden or displease (someone) by underperforming, or by not delivering something promised or hoped for.
defs.ex: His lack of respect disappointed her.

defs.d: To deprive (someone of something expected or hoped for).
Causing disappointment.
defs.ex: disappointing results / news; a disappointing experience

defs.d: A payment made by a tenant at intervals in order to occupy a property.
A similar payment for the use of equipment or a service.
To occupy premises in exchange for rent.
defs.ex: I rented a house from my friend's parents for a year.

defs.d: To grant occupation in return for rent.
defs.ex: We rented our house to our son's friend for a year.

defs.d: A pressing; a force applied to a surface.
defs.ex: Apply pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding.

defs.d: A contrasting force or impulse of any kind
defs.ex: the pressure of poverty; the pressure of taxes; the pressure of motives on the mind; the pressure of civilization.

defs.d: To encourage or heavily exert force or influence.
defs.ex: Do not let anyone pressure you into buying something you do not want.

defs.d: A possible adverse event or outcome
The probability of a negative outcome to a decision or event.
defs.ex: 2006, Trever Ramsey on BBC News website, Exercise 'cuts skin cancer risk' read at http//news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/health/4764535.stm on 14 May 2006

defs.d: To incur risk of (something).
To incur risk of harming or jeopardizing.
Having sufficient or the required properties for a certain purpose or task; appropriate to a certain occasion.
A perceived change in some function, sensation or appearance of a person that indicates a disease or disorder, such as fever, headache or rash.
A signal; anything that indicates, or is characteristic of, the presence of something else, especially of something undesirable.
A person who favors maintenance of the status quo.
Cautious.
Tending to resist change or innovation.
defs.ex: The curriculum committee at this university is extremely conservative.

defs.d: The quality or state of being young.
defs.ex: Her youth and beauty attracted him to her.

defs.d: The part of life following childhood; the period of existence preceding maturity or age; the whole early part of life, from childhood, or, sometimes, from infancy, to adulthood.
defs.ex: I made many mistakes in my youth, but learned from them all.

defs.d: Something added.
Supplemental or added to something.
To discover or find by careful search, examination, or probing
Detected.
